Four export verticals — Beef, Fries, Rice, FMCG — operating simultaneously on a PKR 1.3B capital base. Asset-light start. Bank-leveraged growth. PSX-listed exit within 24 months. Green Heavens owns 100% capital. Harvics builds the architecture.
03 / 25
The opportunity.
The world's most underutilised food export engine. Three markets. Three open windows.
GCC Beef Market
$4.2B in annual demand.
Pakistan captures less than 3% today. The Gulf imports beef by the boatload — and we're three days away by ship.
Explore beef
Frozen Fries Global
$19B market. Pakistan: zero.
A global commodity. Highest-margin frozen vegetable. Pakistani potatoes are competitive and uncontested.
Explore fries
DLTL Rebate
The government pays you 9%.
Direct cash rebate on every Basmati FOB shipment. While the window is open, the state co-funds the trade.
Explore rice
The thesis
The largest arbitrage in South Asia.
The gap between Pakistan's production capacity and its export realisation is the single largest commercial arbitrage available today.
See the products
04 / 25
Why now.
Three forces align in 2026. This window will not repeat.
SBP Export Finance
Capital, subsidised.
EFS rate locked at Policy Rate – 3% = 7.5%. The cheapest export capital in Pakistan's history.
See how we deploy it
DLTL Window Open
The government pays you to ship.
Price cap removed on Basmati. A 9% cash rebate on FOB value. The state finances the cycle.
See the rice play
PKR Stabilised
A clean FX hedge.
PKR/USD steady at 279–280. FE-25 USD loans match USD revenues — zero residual currency exposure.
See the structure
The window
18–24 months.
Then it closes.
As IMF conditionalities tighten, all three forces unwind. Every month of delay is leverage lost forever.
Move now
